welcome_offer.description: Earn 3 Free Night Awards after spending $3,000 on eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening. Each Free Night Award is redeemable for a one-night stay at properties with a redemption level up to 50,000 points.
notes: Official Chase Boundless page checked 2026-10-02 shows 3 Free Night Awards (up to 50k each) after $3,000 in 3 months; the 125k + 1 FNA offer has ended.
Separately, a special offer through 6/30/2027 gives up to $100 in statement credits ($50 semi-annually) after $500 in eligible airline purchases; this is not part of the welcome bonus.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter (DashMart, 7-Eleven, CVS, Safeway, etc.). Requires active DashPass enrollment. Per Chase cobrand-doordash terms.
